Messages.Author: Raven
Messages.Body:
Hello,

I have question about Prisci subreferendum. Let's say there is a situation:

- Political action has been successfully played
- Before any votes and ballots has been cast, Closed Session has been played

Closed Session, action modifier

"Non-Camarilla vampires cannot cast votes in this referendum"

What happens with Prisci subreferendum then?
Can ballots still be cast?
If yes, are votes from prisci subreferendum still valid in this referendum?

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
Use the official card text, your answer is in it.

www.vekn.net/images/stories/downloads/cardlist.txt

Requires a ready prince, justicar or Inner Circle member. Only usable during a referendum, before any votes and ballots are cast.
Non-Camarilla vampires cannot cast votes or ballots in this referendum.

Prince of Paris, France

Ratings Coordinator, Rules Director
